verdict.rationale: The privacy policy briefly mentions 'related Mac OS and mobile applications', but the homepage says there are 'no new interfaces': users text or call the agent. Hands-on reviews describe using it through iMessage and WhatsApp rather than a dedicated app. Missing for 10: any evidence of separate iOS and Android apps, any description of what the mobile apps do or whether they are full-featured, and any hands-on corroboration of a native mobile app.
